class.name: NNBTLeaf
class.brief_description: Scriptable behaviour tree leaf for custom conditions and actions.
class.description: Attach a script overriding [method NNBTTaskNodes.on_tick] to implement custom behaviour tree logic. Prefer [NNBTActionLeaf] for actions that can take multiple ticks and [NNBTConditionLeaf] for instant yes/no checks. [gdscript] func on_tick(delta: float) -> Status: return Status.SUCCESS [/gdscript] You can also add child [NNConsiderations] nodes when this leaf is a direct child of an [NNBTScoreBasedPicker].
